title: Who Is Basil? The Ghost of the Hatton Garden Heist
description:
Over Easter weekend in 2015, a gang of elderly thieves drilled through reinforced concrete into London's Hatton Garden Safe Deposit. Despite an alarm tripping at 00:21, police never responded, and the crew spent 72 hours cracking open 73 boxes containing millions in gold, gems, and cash.

Ringleader Brian Reader was 76 years old. His crew averaged 66. They were caught weeks later after driving past CCTV on real plates and bragging in a bugged pub. Nine arrests, fast convictions, case closed.

Except one man captured on grainy vault footage was never identified. Police called him Basil. No name, no face, no arrest. Ten years later, he remains a ghost.
